text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At long last, the journey through the 
Twinkle Series alongside Biwa Hayahide 
begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In her youth, panicked by the fear of 
losing to her younger sister, Narita 
Brian, she broke down during a race. Lying 
on that hospital bed, she made a vow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If my younger sister possesses 
extraordinary "genius," then I shall 
construct a "theory" to surpass it. All so 
I won't lose to her next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to complete her "theory"—the 
"Formula for Victory"— the days of walking 
side by side with Biwa Hayahide had begun.
